name: Gece Pikniği
scene: A masked raccoon holds picnic fruit beside a basket in a moonlit woodland, its ringed tail curling across the foreground.
notes: Design sheet only. Both generations visually inspected for open lines, X crossings, shading and colour pairs; one regeneration completed, and the simpler second composition selected. Remaining issues: subtle shading persists; finger strokes end inside paws; some crowded or potentially four-way contacts remain around ears, foliage and basket; a few narrow regions remain. Colour-pair exceptions include the blue nose, turquoise fruit leaf/stem, and copper background branches. Adjacent same-colour regions will need merging or recolouring during tracing. Raster estimate is 163 coloured connected components of at least 100 pixels, exceeding the 95–135 target; this is not a validated geometry pane count. Simplify background subdivisions and basket detail while preserving the raccoon silhouette before geometry production. Not audited playable geometry or finished glass artwork.
